item.title: Game Theory Turn Sequencing
item.description: Turn Sequencing essentially refers to the way you structure your turns. It’s something that not everybody thinks about. To me, as a person that tends to get distracted a lot and lose focus in game, specially at tournaments, having a structured way to think about your turn makes it easier to find your way back to the game and reduce the amount of mistakes caused by distraction. Time Management is a fundamental skill in any game.
